steps.message:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-26, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 17.9 | 13.68 | 13.68
2 | 50.4 | 5.82 | 19.50
3 | 514.6 | 0.68 | 20.18
4 | 502.0 | 17.67 | 37.85
5 | 194.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as AKQ-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-26, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station T-26 (Area T)**

**Layer Sequence Summary:**
* **Layer 1** (0–13.68 m): 17.9 Ω·m (low-resistivity overburden)
* **Layer 2** (13.68–19.50 m): 50.4 Ω·m
* **Layer 3** (19.50–20.18 m): 514.6 Ω·m (resistive thin bed)
* **Layer 4** (20.18–37.85 m): 502.0 Ω·m
* **Layer 5** (>37.85 m): 194.4 Ω·m (conductive basement/target)

**Curve Evaluation:**
Evaluating consecutive layer triplets gives:
* Layers 1-2-3: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$ (A-type)
* Layers 2-3-4: $\rho_2 < \rho_3 > \rho_4$ (K-type)
* Layers 3-4-5: $\rho_3 > \rho_4 > \rho_5$ (Q-type)

The five-layer sounding yields an **AKQ** curve type, confirming that the classification on file accurately fits the layer resistivity data.
